manifest.preregistration: cycle-length-feasibility-r1; ONE exclusive attempt; no in-place retry

pure_periodic_balanced_peaks.interpretation: Physical stride P remains observable in gyro; acceleration has exactly balanced steps and period P/2.

weak_degenerate_gyro.interpretation: Physical stride P; almost constant gyro magnitude should fail the frozen channel guard if a pair exists.

manifest.nested_generation: Generate six-axis N768 once per fixture; copy its prefix256; independently generate256 solely for bitwise prefix control. Never concatenate windows.
manifest.execution_order: First all 1280 exact N256 records, compare ALL cached keys with exact float bits and expected counts; STOP on any mismatch. Only after success, candidate N256 and both N768 rules plus N768-only diagnostics.

detector.pearson: np.corrcoef(y[:-L],y[L:])[0,1]; standard clipping; finite lags only
detector.exact: Largest computed value, smallest lag among exact equals

candidate.selection: smallest lag in entire nearmax set; PUTATIVE repeat interval, never anatomical-stride inference

minima_pair.minima: strict immediate-neighbor minima of filtered acceleration magnitude
minima_pair.pairs: all ordered minima pairs a<b with 80<=b-a<=200 and abs((b-a)-L)<=0.1*L

features.channels: raw acceleration and gyro magnitudes; retain six raw axes in NPZ
features.spline: natural CubicSpline, 200 endpoint-inclusive points each channel
features.normalize: center; population std(ddof0); concatenate acc then gyro; unit L2 norm
features.hard_guard: raw spline RMS==0 OR population std<=1e-12*raw spline RMS for either channel
features.invalid: separate bool valid mask and all-NaN 400-vector; no score sentinel; no auth scores

diagnostics_768_only.anchors: np.arange(10,N-410); 10..357; SAME 348 pairs at EVERY lag
diagnostics_768_only.calculation: np.corrcoef stacked four anchors and four shifted channels; take corresponding 4 cross entries; float64
diagnostics_768_only.gaps: max-minus-selected, top-minus-second, max-minus-largest-outside-nearset; all defined with explicit finite counts
diagnostics_768_only.harmonics: report P/2,P,2P whenever in 40..400, plus every multiple of analytic observable period <=400 (P/2 for balanced acceleration, P otherwise)
diagnostics_768_only.extraction_effect: NONE; never rescue, reject, impute, or change selected extraction

fixed_numerical_checks.checks: Both tile-sine correlations and exactly equal artificial maxima vector: all nine Cartesian shifts {-1,0,+1} ULP at lags100,200 only; every other lag unchanged. Also reverse enumeration for every vector.
fixed_numerical_checks.requirements: candidate lag100 and nearset[100,200] stable for all fixed vectors and reversed enumeration; exact divergence expected and logged
fixed_numerical_checks.boundary_scope: No robustness claim at arbitrary 1e-10 membership boundaries

geometric_reference.definition: Continuous local minima of prescribed RAW acceleration norm, independently enumerated; not theta0 stride events and not detected filtered minima
geometric_reference.gravity_and_weak: negative-to-positive roots of a(theta).a'(theta) on fixed 4096 subintervals [-pi/4096,2pi-pi/4096]; brentq xtol1e-14,rtol4eps; positive curvature; enumerate all roots; require exactly one minimum
geometric_reference.enumeration: times=P*(k+root_phase-j/32); keep [10,N-11]; all continuous minima pairs with same 80..200, +/-10% selected-lag constraints; no snapping, no tolerance rescue
geometric_reference.pair_delta: same-root difference computed as integer cycle difference*P; otherwise (cycle difference+root phase difference)*P
geometric_reference.report: all reference minima and eligible pairs, chosen reference pair, availability, phase holes, observed/reference disagreement; geometry is not an extraction guarantee

truth_reporting.events: P*(k-j/32) in sample interval and interior margins; labels are stipulated
truth_reporting.alias: nearest of 0.5,1,2 within relative10%; otherwise other; unavailable if absent; metadata only
truth_reporting.balanced_limit: Acceleration alone cannot identify physical P because its period is P/2. Gyro magnitude 40-8*cos(theta) contains P; THIS joint-magnitude fixture is not unidentifiable. Unique nearmax does not imply stride.
truth_reporting.general_limit: Identical joint magnitudes can in general be ambiguous; no extra generator is implemented or tested

manifest.scope: Standalone synthetic only. No real TRAIN/DEV/data/archive/CALIB/TEST, fitting, installs, Git, SSH, child agents, noise/gain/conditions/seed/parameter search or old-artifact writes.

idnet.context: Eight normalized channels, orientation transform and adaptive templates are absent here; this is not IDNet recreation

derawi.context: Longer-walk cycle detection does not establish this synthetic window's coverage; DOI metadata supplied in brief and original r1, DOI endpoint unavailable during preparation

manifest.length_rationale: Researcher's fixed N768 is first multiple of256 greater than 3*Pmax+2*margin=620; geometric rationale only, never an empirical optimum or gait guarantee
manifest.review: Root independently reviews before any publication or real DEV plan; no publication or real-data authorization inferred

legacy_comparison.numeric_comparison: Float.hex exact; missing keys compared; no tolerance

fixed_numerical_checks.scope: These 18 frozen vectors only; no assertion about arbitrary values at the 1e-10 set boundary

scientific_limits: Only four noiseless analytic fixtures, two preregistered lengths and two rules; these counts do not estimate gait, subject, session, authentication or real-DEV performance.
N768's 620-sample geometric rationale is not an empirical optimum or sufficient condition for correct stride extraction or finite features.
Balanced acceleration has period P/2; physical stride is unidentifiable from acceleration alone. Its gyro magnitude has period P, so joint magnitudes in THIS fixture are not unidentifiable.
In general identical joint magnitudes can be ambiguous, but no additional generator was planned or tested. Full-signal and extracted-interval aliases are separately flagged.
Nearmax selection stabilizes only the fixed numerical checks. A unique nearmax set, high correlation, or finite feature does not identify anatomical stride.
Long-window harmonic diagnostics use common fixed anchors and never rescue extraction. Filter boundaries can change observed minima relative to independent raw-minimum geometry.
Hard near-flat gyro guards remain failures without imputation. Aliases remain extraction successes when features are finite; no quality cutoff is trained or applied.
IDNet section3's eight channels, orientation transform and adaptive templates are absent; this two-magnitude experiment is not an IDNet reproduction. Derawi paper is 2010 DOI10.1109/IIHMSP.2010.84.
Independent root review is required before publication or any real DEV plan. No such work is performed here.

storage.mapping: NPZ record_mapping indexed by row_id; correlations indexed by correlation_row; diagnostic arrays indexed by fixture_index
storage.partial_arrays: arrays/*.npy preserve all allocated partial state; present masks distinguish unmeasured values
storage.dtype: lossless float64; invalid features NaN with separate bool mask; no pickle; no scores
